Each card asks trainees to **bet** before they roll or spin. The cards follow
the FAO training deck (*Data Collection and Estimation of Fisheries
Quantities: multi-stage sampling*), then go beyond it to the field problems
real surveys have.

```{r intro}
library(casimir)
fish <- cas_fishery(island_x(), seed = 1)
year <- max(fish$years)
truth <- cas_truth(fish, years = year, by = "year")
```

# Card 0: one site-day by hand

::: {.predict}
**Bet.** At the busiest site-day of the sample, what is the catch of
*Scomber colias* by canoes? Work it out from Forms A to C, then check.
:::

```{r card-0}
s <- draw_sample(fish, cas_design(), seed = 1)
e <- estimate_catch(s)
busy <- names(which.max(tapply(s$A$N, s$A$psu, sum)))
s$A[s$A$psu == busy, ]
b <- s$B[s$B$psu == busy & s$B$segment == "canoe", ]
c0 <- s$C[s$C$psu == busy & s$C$species == "Scomber colias", ]
merge(b, c0[c("trip", "w_s")], all.x = TRUE)
e$psu[e$psu$psu == busy & e$psu$segment == "canoe", c("N", "n", "Scomber colias")]
```

::: {.info}
**Steps 1 and 2.** Each landing: species share of the subsample times the
landed weight. The site-day: mean of the sampled landings times the number
counted (N/n x sum).
:::

# Card 1: from site-days to the stratum

::: {.predict}
**Bet.** The busy site-day above is one of M site-days in its stratum. What
happens to the estimate if days without landings are left out?
:::

```{r card-1}
ev0 <- replicate_design(fish, cas_design(), R = 100, seed = 2)
ev1 <- replicate_design(fish, cas_design(), R = 100, seed = 2,
                        artefacts = artefacts(dropped_zeros = TRUE))
data.frame(species = ev0$summary$species,
           bias_all_days = round(ev0$summary$rel_bias, 2),
           bias_dropped_zeros = round(ev1$summary$rel_bias, 2))
```

::: {.flag}
**Zeros are data.** Dropping empty days makes M/m raise only the busy days.
On Island X most site-days have landings, so the effect is small here; at
small sites, or in the off season, empty days are common and the bias grows.
:::

# Card 2: days or boats?

::: {.predict}
**Bet.** For about the same cost: many site-days with one landing per
segment, or few site-days with several?
:::

```{r card-2, fig.height = 6}
designs <- days_vs_boats(budget_m = 16, n = 1, steps = 3)
sapply(designs, design_cost, fishery = fish)
cmp <- compare_designs(fish, designs, R = 100, seed = 3)
plot_eval(cmp)
```

::: {.info}
**Landings on the same day are alike.** The variance between site-days
dominates, so more site-days buy more precision than more landings per day.
:::

# Card 3: find the high roller

::: {.predict}
**Bet.** One enumerator picks the biggest boats. Which species are
over-estimated, and by how much?
:::

```{r card-3, fig.height = 6}
ok <- replicate_design(fish, cas_design(), R = 100, seed = 4)
hr <- replicate_design(fish, cas_design(), R = 100, seed = 4,
                       artefacts = artefacts(high_roller = 1))
plot_eval(rbind(data.frame(design = "honest", ok$summary),
                data.frame(design = "high roller", hr$summary)))
```

::: {.flag}
**Warning flag.** Sampled landings much larger than the typical landing at a
site. Bias does not shrink with more samples.
:::

# Card 4: who lands after lunch?

::: {.predict}
**Bet.** The enumerator leaves at 13:00. Which segment and which species are
under-estimated?
:::

```{r card-4}
sw <- replicate_design(fish, cas_design(), R = 100, seed = 5,
                       artefacts = artefacts(short_watch = 13))
data.frame(species = sw$summary$species, bias = round(sw$summary$rel_bias, 2))
```

::: {.info}
**Long trips land late.** Large motor boats fish far offshore for pelagic
species and land in the afternoon; a short watch misses them.
:::

# Card 5: two routes to the catch

::: {.predict}
**Bet.** The frame survey is three years old. Which route is biased: raising
by site-days, or CPUE x effort?
:::

```{r card-5}
a <- artefacts(old_frame = 3)
psu <- replicate_design(fish, cas_design(), R = 100, seed = 6, artefacts = a)
eff <- replicate_design(fish, cas_design(), R = 100, seed = 6, artefacts = a, route = "effort")
data.frame(species = psu$summary$species,
           bias_psu = round(psu$summary$rel_bias, 2),
           bias_effort = round(eff$summary$rel_bias, 2))
```
